items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I said, “That’s that number, Crosby, Stills, and Nash.”

ctx.x: Yeah, those, that group. This was a thing that had pretty guitar part in it, so he came, I was sitting down, he was playing. I said, “That’s that number, Crosby, Stills, and Nash.” And then it’s intricate, you know, he says, “Yeah, yeah, that’s what it is.” So he taught him how to play first then he got into all the scales. Then he went to all this school, he had all these good teachers. He went to the Harvard School. You know where the Harvard School is here?
